assumptions_warnings: LVEF not documented – NICE NG106 recommends disease‑modifying drugs only for HFrEF (LVEF ≤40%). Arrange echocardiogram before finalising beta‑blocker, MRA, and SGLT2‑i regimen.
Conflicting eGFR values (49.1 mL/min and 11.5 mL/min). Verify current renal function; if eGFR <30 mL/min, stop metformin and adjust doses of ACE‑I, MRA, and SGLT2‑i accordingly.
Serum potassium not provided. Must obtain baseline K⁺ before starting spironolactone and repeat after dose changes.
Allergy status to sulfonamides unknown – required before prescribing dapagliflozin.
HbA1c 3.1 % indicates overtreatment; insulin dose reduction is required prior to adding SGLT2‑i to avoid severe hypoglycaemia.
Blood pressure 142/100 mmHg above target (<130/80 mmHg). Additional antihypertensive optimisation may be needed after beta‑blocker titration.
treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril, metformin and insulin (with dose reduction) and add bisoprolol, spironolactone (if K⁺ ≤5.0 mmol/L and eGFR ≥30), and dapagliflozin 10 mg daily as first‑line disease‑modifying therapy for HFrEF per NICE NG106. Provide furosemide PRN for congestion. Monitor BP, renal function, electrolytes, and glucose closely, and obtain echocardiogram to confirm HFrEF phenotype before full titration.
